# scm_certificate_import (Action)

Import a certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import a certificate into Strata Cloud Manager.
#
# Usage:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.scm_certificate_import.tls_cert

action "scm_certificate_import" "tls_cert" {
  config {
    folder           = "All"
    name             = "scm_certificate_import"
    certificate_file = ""
    format           = "pem"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate_file` (String) The Base64 encoded content of the certificate public key
- `format` (String) Certificate format. Possible values are `pem`, `pkcs12` and `der`.
- `name` (String) The name of the certificate

### Optional

- `device` (String) The device in which the resource is defined
- `folder` (String) The folder in which the resource is defined
- `key_file` (String) The Base64 encoded content of the certificate private key
- `passphrase` (String) Passphrase to protect the certificate private key
- `snippet` (String) The snippet in which the resource is defined
